reserveReview.rationale: At August 31, 2026, 5:00 PM Eastern Time, the report discloses USD 31,173,738.08 in U.S. Treasury bills and USD 20,717,851.25 in cash deposits. The complete gross holdings denominator is USD 51,891,589.33. Independently reproduced division and two-decimal rounding yield 60.07% bills and 39.93% cash. The separately disclosed negative USD 97,070.46 net-other-assets/liabilities adjustment reconciles gross holdings to the reported USD 51,794,518.87 net asset value; it is not assigned to a reserve asset category. This preserves the existing gross-holdings basis. The latest disclosed bill maturity, October 1, is 31 calendar days after August 31.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete gross holdings in PwC's FIDD examination at August 31, 2026, 5:00 PM Eastern Time; USD 51,891,589.33 denominator, with negative net-other-assets/liabilities separately reconciled to reported NAV
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material gross reserve asset-class exposure is unclassified; the report separately discloses a negative net-other-assets-and-liabilities adjustment and identifies BNY Mellon as the sole reserve account provider at period end.
